'''Dion Waiters''' (born December 1, 1991) is a [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] at [[Syracuse Orange basketball|Syracuse]]. He is considered one of the top prospects for the [[2012 NBA Draft]].<ref>http://insider.espn.go.com/nba/draft/results/top100</ref>

==High School==
Waiters enrolled at  [[Bartram High School]], but transferred to South as a freshman. He did not play basketball at either school. In his sophomore year of high school, Waiters attended [[South Kent School]]. Waiters then played basketball at [[Life Center Academy]] his junior and senior years. Following his senior year, Waiters was ranked as the fifteenth best overall recruit according to [[ESPNU]]. Waiters was also ranked as the twenty-ninth best overall recruit by [[Rivals.com]].<ref name=syracuseprofile /> 
==College career==
===Freshman season===
In his freshman season at Syracuse, Waiters averaged 6.6 points, 1.5 assists and 1.6 rebounds per game.<ref name=espnprofile>{{cite web|title=Dion Waiters Stats|url=http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/51344/dion-waiters|work=espn.go.com|accessdate=19 June 2012}}</ref> In a second round loss to [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]] in the NCAA Tournament, Waiters shot 8-for-10 with 18 points.<ref name=syracuseprofile>{{cite web|title=Dion Waiters profile|url=http://www.suathletics.com/roster.aspx?rp_id=7773&path=mbasket|work=syracuseathletics.com|accessdate=19 June 2012}}</ref>
===Sophomore season===
In his sophomore season at Syracuse, Waiters averaged 12.6 points, 2.5 assists and 2.3 rebounds per game.<ref name=espnprofile /> He was also named AP Honorable Mention All-American.<ref>{{cite web|title=Lamb named AP Honorable Mention All-America|url=http://www.uconnhuskies.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/032712aab.html|work=uconnhuskies.com|accessdate=19 June 2012}}</ref>
